unresolved_gaps: No accounting basis or specific loss measure is supplied by the claim.
The subscription evidence does not measure delivery costs or realised customer usage.
The available task studies do not establish how representative the asserted defects and oversight requirements are across practical work.
The claim supplies no quality standard against which mediocre output can be consistently judged.
